AND MATCH(TITLE, CONTENT) AGAINST(#{keyword} IN BOOLEAN MODE)

SELECT /* selectDeleteBoardList */ B.BOARD_ID , B.TITLE , B.CONTENT , B.BOARD_TYPE , B.CATEGORY , B.VIEW_COUNT , B.LIKE_COUNT , B.TAG_NAME , B.CREATE_AT , B.UPDATE_AT , M.USER_ID , M.USER_NAME , M.PROFILE_IMAGE , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM COMMENT_MANAGEMENT CM WHERE CM.BOARD_ID = B.BOARD_ID ) AS commentCount /* 전체 댓글(삭제된 댓글 포함) 수 표시 */ FROM BOARD B INNER JOIN(SELECT BOARD_ID FROM BOARD WHERE DELETE_YN = 'Y'
AND MATCH(TITLE, CONTENT) AGAINST(#{keyword} IN BOOLEAN MODE)
ORDER BY UPDATE_AT DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size} )AS temp ON B.BOARD_ID = temp.BOARD_ID LEFT JOIN MEMBER_INFO M ON B.MEMBER_ID =M.MEMBER_ID ORDER BY B.UPDATE_AT DESC
SELECT USER_ROLE FROM MEMBER_INFO WHERE MEMBER_ID = #{memberId}
SELECT /* AdminMapper.getMemberRole 사용자 Role 조회 */ MEMBER_ID , USER_ID , USER_NAME , USER_ROLE FROM MEMBER_INFO WHERE MEMBER_ID = #{memberId}
SELECT /* AdminMapper.getMemberList (전체 회원 정보 조회 (Admin)) */ MEMBER_ID , USER_ID , USER_NAME , USER_ROLE , USER_EMAIL , USER_STATUS , LAST_LOG_AT FROM MEMBER_INFO
mapper.update: UPDATE BOARD SET DELETE_YN = 'N' , UPDATE_AT = NOW() WHERE BOARD_ID = #{boardId}
